2014_spells.locate-animals-or-plants.des: Describe or name a specific kind of beast or plant. Concentrating on the voice of nature in your surroundings, you learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any are present.
2014_spells.locate-animals-or-plants.eff: Reveal magical or hidden information within range
2014_spells.locate-animals-or-plants.ful: Using 1 action, describe or name a specific kind of beast or plant. Concentrating on the voice of nature in your surroundings, you learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any are present. The effect happens immediately and then ends; you can cast it as a ritual.
